falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes at least 4.0% above today's close within 14 calendar days and finishes that window at a new 20-day closing high.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A clear upside resolution would falsify both HOLD and the mini_top_2019_jun analog: the setup was continuation, not an unresolved mini-top, so UNKNOWN/HOLD was the wrong call.

falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes at least 6.0% below today's close within 14 calendar days, or the VIX index closes at or above 30 on any session in that window.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A sharp drawdown or volatility spike would show the pattern already resolved as risk-off rather than an unknown hold, invalidating UNKNOWN, HOLD, and a mere mini-top classification.

falsification_conditions.condition: US high-yield option-adjusted spread widens by 75 basis points or more versus today's close, or the 10-year US Treasury yield moves 40 basis points or more in either direction, within 14 calendar days.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A rates or credit regime break would prove the moderate blowoff score (56) and 77% mini-top match did not describe a stable hold state, so the UNKNOWN verdict failed.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
